---
title: "07 · Audit real feature matrices"
description: "Use disagreement with the Gaussian baseline as a diagnostic."
---

```python
import numpy as np
from rpgeom import audit

rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
X = rng.standard_normal((1200, 128))
report = audit(X, m=32, q=10, n_trials=1500, rng=rng)
print(report)
```

The audit reports two spectral diagnostics before sampling a map:

- `r2` describes the relative distance-fluctuation scale;
- `alpha_m` is the optimal spectrum-aware distance-value share.

Measured order survival can depart from the isotropic law because of clusters,
low intrinsic dimension, tails, or anisotropy. The audit exposes that departure;
it does not relabel it as failure.
